# IV) CLASSIFICATION

## 3) Random Forest Classifier of Ensemble

This time we shall use the algorithm of \textcolor{red}{Random Forest Classification} to classify the datasets of iris.

```{python}

import numpy as np 
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd  

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error,mean_absolute_error, r2_score
```

```{python}

iris = load_iris()
y = iris.target
X = iris.data

modele = RandomForestClassifier()
modele.fit(X, y)

y_pred = modele.predict(X)
R2_sc = r2_score(y, y_pred)
R2 = modele.score(X, y)

mse = mean_squared_error(y, y_pred)
rmse = mean_squared_error(y, y_pred, squared = False)
mae = mean_absolute_error(y, y_pred)

print(f"\nScore (Error in the prediction): {R2}")
print(f"Score (Error in the datasets): {R2_sc}\n")

print(f"MSE = {mse}")
print(f"RMSE = {rmse}")
print(f"MAE = {mae}")

plt.scatter(X[:,0], y, c = 'b', label = 'Real datasets')
plt.scatter(X[:,0], y_pred, c = 'r', label = 'Prediciton datasets')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
plt.close()
```
